text:
Maya: Hemlock just pinged AE  they ran into a FedRAMP blocker during migration validation. Can we repurpose today's 2pm office hour for a focused security + sandbox walkthrough?
Ethan: I can lead the demo but need a security SME for the compliance Q&A. Neha available?
Neha: Yes I can cover FedRAMP Q&A (10-15m). Morning PT would be better for their infra folks.
Priya: Hemlock suggested 11:00 or 11:30 PT. Which works for coverage?
Lars: 11:30 PT keeps more folks available on our side. I can swap my 1pm customer call.
Maya: Great. @cs_scheduler_bot can you create an event titled "Hemlock - FedRAMP sandbox review" at 11:30 PT and add Hemlock_CISO + infra@hemlock.com and #solutions?
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event... ✅ Invite created: https://cal.redwood.com/event/hemlock-fedramp-1999990001 (11:30 PT / 18:30 UTC). Reminders: 30m & 10m.
Ethan: We need a scrubbed demo dataset. Priya, can you own the scrub or should Lars do it?
Lars: I can scrub and snapshot the sandbox. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sandbox-scrub. Will upload by 11:00 PT.
Priya: Draft agenda (tight):
```
11:30 - 11:35 Goals + success criteria (Maya)
11:35 - 11:55 Live sandbox demo: hosted baseline + isolation notes (Ethan)
11:55 - 12:10 Compliance Q&A: FedRAMP, data residency, KMS (Neha)
12:10 - 12:15 Actions & owners + next steps (Priya)
```
Maya: Need a clear owner for post-call follow-ups so any renewal signals are captured. Priya?
Priya: I'll own follow-ups and add a "renewal-risk" tag to the account health doc if they request on-prem timelines > 90 days or extended SLA terms.
Ethan: I'll record the demo and upload clips; also add a slide comparing Hosted vs Dedicated isolation.
Lars: Sandbox snapshot link to event doc when done: will be https://internal.redwood/artifacts/hemlock-snap-1999990001. PII scrubbed using scrub-v2.
Neha: I'll prep a 1-page FedRAMP checklist + 3 quick answers for common migration Qs to paste in chat.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Lars. Invites resent. Reminder scheduled.
Hemlock_CISO: (external) Confirmed 11:30 PT works for our security team. Please include the checklist and a short pre-read.
Maya: Pre-read: https://internal.redwood/docs/hemlock-fedramp-pre-read (shared).
Priya: Post-call pulse we'll run: (1) Did this resolve your blocker? (Y/N) (2) Confidence to proceed on migration (1-5). I'll attach the score to the account health doc.
Ethan: If they ask about air-gapped or on-prem options, escalate to Solutions and tag AE. That will be a renewal signal.
Maya: Pre-call sync at 11:00 DM huddle for last-minute handoffs. Neha, Lars, Ethan join?
Neha: Yes. I'll be on standby from 10:4511:15 for pre-call.
Lars: Uploading snapshot now.
cs_scheduler_bot: Snapshot uploaded and event doc linked by Lars.
Priya: Thanks team. See you at 11:00 pre-call. :thumbsup:
